components.css: .ds-signal-board { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: var(--night); border: 1px solid var(--night); color: #f1f1eb; } .ds-signal-board::after { position: absolute; top: 0; left: -35%; width: 32%; height: 2px; background: var(--orange); content: ""; animation: ds-signal-scan 2.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 350ms 1 both; } .ds-signal-heading { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-dark); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-signal-live { color: #b9d9c5; } .ds-signal-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } .ds-signal-grid a { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 158px; padding: 22px 20px; border-right: 1px solid var(--line-dark); color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-signal-grid a:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-signal-grid a:hover { background: var(--night-raised); } .ds-signal-grid strong { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: clamp(30px, 4vw, 48px); line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-signal-grid span { margin-top: 10px; color: #d1d2cc; font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 13px; } .ds-signal-grid small { margin-top: auto; color: var(--orange); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; } .ds-signal-grid a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: -4px; } @keyframes ds-signal-scan { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(430%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-signal-board::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms; animation-iteration-count: 1; } }

narrative.overview:
The system combines Learn's editorial restraint with OMA's evidence-board discipline. It should feel like a public operating record: warm paper and near-black fields, hard dividers, mono-led headlines, dated facts, and controls that look ready to be used rather than admired.

Proof creates the visual hierarchy. Large numbers, source labels, ledger rows, and real screenshots carry the page; orange is a scarce signal for action, verification, and measured facts. The system rejects ornamental agency language, soft card grids, and decoration without evidentiary purpose.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and near-black sections alternate to establish chapters.
JetBrains Mono carries proof, hierarchy, navigation, labels, and controls.
IBM Plex Sans keeps explanatory copy calm and readable.
One-pixel rules and square corners make every surface feel ledger-like.
Real screenshots and attributable metrics are the principal visual media.

rules.name: The Receipt Before Accent Rule
rules.body: Orange marks action, verification, or a measured fact; it never floods a page as decoration.

rules.name: The Mono Carries Proof Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono carries headings, metrics, controls, labels, and links; IBM Plex Sans carries explanation.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated with tonal shifts and one-pixel rules; shadows are not part of the vocabulary.

rules.name: The Square Contract Rule
rules.body: Interactive controls, panels, fields, and cards use zero radius; circles are reserved for compact status indicators.

dos: Do lead with a concrete artifact, metric, source, or dated status.
Do alternate light and dark chapters to clarify the narrative sequence.
Do keep components square and separate them with one-pixel rules.
Do preserve the mono/sans division between proof language and explanation.
Do provide visible focus and a reduced-motion path for every interaction.
donts: Don't turn the catalog into an undifferentiated grid of generic cards.
Don't use orange as an ambient background or decorative wash.
Don't add shadows, soft radii, glass cards, or ornamental illustration.
Don't present a metric without its source and date context.
Don't shrink dense evidence to preserve desktop columns on a narrow screen.
